methodology.primary_sample: All eligible category-A N resales by PPD F/T/S/D type; price-only sample does not require an EPC size match, limiting selection bias.
methodology.geography: PPD district must agree with source LA; postcode must occur in that LA EPC input. Size match also requires EPC LA equality. Postcode evidence is not polygon boundary verification.
methodology.matching: Exact ordered normalized SAON+PAON+street (+optional exact PPD locality), postcode, unique EPC UPRN/address identity. No token subset, number-only or fuzzy matching. F requires Flat/Maisonette; T/S/D require House/Bungalow and consistent built form.
methodology.temporal: Latest EPC at/before sale; inspection cannot be after sale. Older than 3652 days excluded from sizes. EPC source is already latest-only; missing historical certificates cannot be recovered. Post-sale-only matches never backfilled.
methodology.outliers: Each geography/type/size or proxy group: Tukey 1.5 IQR fences only when raw n>=20 and IQR>0. Linear type-7 quartiles. Raw and clean counts/medians/IQR retained; audit lists every group-specific exclusion. No hard price or area ceiling.
methodology.uncertainty: n<20 sparse; n<5 omv null. Nominal recorded transaction medians, NOT professionally assessed current OMV; no time adjustment. Registration lag, condition/lease terms, unmatched EPC size selection remain limitations.
methodology.bedrooms_lha: EPC habitable rooms are NOT bedrooms. Legacy flat1/flat2/house2/house3 are explicit room proxies, bedrooms null. LHA/yields null because postcode BRMA and actual bedrooms/eligibility are unverified. No council-average LHA or city-rent yield claimed.
methodology.reproduction: python scripts/lha_omv.py; input SHA256 and row-level reasons in valuation_audit.json. No upstream downloads.
